title: wg: protocol-06 §5.6 GroupInfo HPKE suite unspecified
description: Suggestion. protocol-06 §5.6 says which cipher_suite signs the request/response but not which suite's HPKE (KEM/KDF/AEAD) encrypts encrypted_groupinfo_and_tree with groupInfoPublicKey. Implementations with different suites will fail to decrypt. mimid uses suite 1 (decision mimid-1wgh.5.55). Fix: state that the request's cipher_suite (or the room's MLS suite) determines the HPKE algorithms.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED: GroupInfo HPKE suite implicit (group's), joiner may not know it. Typos groupInfoPublcKey, version/protocol. New issue + editorial.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/155
